hero.title: Think you've got the perfect job? Why not tell a student how to get there?
hero.body: We're looking for mentors on every level of the corporate totem pole. Encourage employees to volunteer, or sponsor the cost of a school talk. Every little bit helps.

ways.title: People (social) and money (capital)
ways.body: We're helping to bring intangible information to students, help us get there faster by supporting us.

items.title: Encourage staff to volunteer
items.body: Employees who volunteer get listed under their industry, and can include their company name. Students reach out to them to learn more

items.title: Sponsor a School seminar
items.body: Pay a mentor's fee for their time and travel, usually €50 to €150, making it easier for our volunteers to give up their time.

items.title: Sponsor the platform
items.body: We are currently looking for sponsors to help fund the programme and all the work that is involved. If you would like your companies name mentioned on the website, then please get in touch to arrange a sponsorship or donation.

cta.title: Want to learn more?
cta.body: We're happy to share more details, or to work with you to provide guidance for how you can make the biggest difference.
